author: nero_eth
content:
It hasn't been documented and isn't super clear but at least for glamsterdam, we took the client priorities + steel assessment + recommendations by researchers/core devs for ordering them. E.g. it was probably smart to not wait for the last devnet for 8037, whereas and eip like 7976 could wait, even though it was ranked high at clients.
At the same time, things that were simple and ranked highest (eip-7778) where included in devnet-0 without much hesitation.

author: nero_eth
content: Not sure we need to define that process better. Maybe it's fine if random individuals just propose eips for devnet scopes. Not sure there's a better way that allows us to still stay a bit flexible.

content: my issue is that adding things to devnets is then we often end up in the sunk cost fallacy of "well we already did a bunch of the work" and that's how we end up with huge unfocused forks
